test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
Identify the cultural festival on the basis of given clues:

i) This festival brings together craftsmen like potters, embroiderers, weavers, wood carvers, metal workers, stone smiths and painters from all over India on one platform in Haryana.

ii) This crafts mela is held in February every year and provides a glimpse of the state’s cultural heritage and recent achievements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surajkund Mela**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Surajkund Mela **is a craft fair showcasing local traditions, art, and culinary delights, offering a glimpse into global culture with participation from over 20 countries across South Asia, Africa, and Europe.
 
• Scheduled to run from **February 2nd to February 18th, 2024**, from 10 AM to 7 PM daily, the 2024 Surajkund Mela will feature state stalls, cultural programs, and performances from various countries and regions, celebrating diversity and creativity.
 
• Organized by the Surajkund Mela Authority and Haryana Tourism in collaboration with Union Ministries of Tourism, Textiles, Culture, and External Affairs, the event promises to be a vibrant celebration of craftsmanship and cultural exchange.
 
• Additionally, for the 37th Surajkund International Crafts Mela-2022, the state of Gujarat has been selected as the Theme State, adding a unique dimension to the festivities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Kapil Muni Fair **is celebrated in Rajasthan during Kartik Purnima, the full moon day, in Kolayat, Bikaner, and is renowned for its popularity.
 
• In Gujarat,** the Shamlaji Fair,** also known as the Shamlaji Melo or Kartik Purnima fair, is an annual event observed on Karthiki Purnima.
 
• **Chitra Vichitra **Fair, a tribal celebration held in the village of Gubhakhari in the Sabarkantha District of Gujarat, India.
